goal: Decide whether a UOR Atlas UTQC dictionary row passes the honesty meta-gate, so no row asserts more than its source shows.

app.name: utqc-row-honesty
app.title: UTQC row honesty
app.purpose: Decide whether one dictionary row is admitted by the honesty audit, or which status-discipline rule it breaks first.

fields.name: status
fields.means: the honesty level of the row in model/status.toml

fields.name: source
fields.means: whether the source is an external anchor or a parenthetical in-repo derivation

fields.name: oracle
fields.means: whether the oracle is external or the in-repo exact-algebra certificate

fields.name: tier
fields.means: whether the feature is a gating suite or a non-gating target

fields.name: cited
fields.means: cited classical lemmas the row declares

fields.name: disclosed
fields.means: cited lemmas that appear verbatim in the row atlas prose

meanings.admitted: the row passes the honesty meta-gate and its feature may run at its tier
meanings.anchor-missing: a some-true row has an in-repo derivation for its source
meanings.oracle-misused: a some-true row is backed by the in-repo exact-algebra oracle
meanings.tier-violated: an open row is placed in a gating suite
meanings.citation-refused: cited lemmas are declared by a non-asserting row or are not disclosed in its prose

rules.why: crates/tqc-conformance/src/honesty.rs: some-true requires an external source anchor, never (derived)
crates/tqc-conformance/src/honesty.rs: the in-repo exact-algebra oracle cannot back a some-true row
crates/tqc-conformance/src/honesty.rs and model/status.toml: open is non-gating and may not be a gating suite
crates/tqc-conformance/src/honesty.rs: a non-asserting status may not declare cited lemmas
crates/tqc-conformance/src/honesty.rs: each cited lemma must appear verbatim in the row atlas prose

app.otherwiseWhy: docs/conceptual-model/03-status-discipline.md: the status is a contract the row keeps

properties.why: 03-status-discipline.md external-anchor rule: derived constructions belong at build
03-status-discipline.md: an open claim is measured and reported, never green
an open row asserts nothing, so it rests on no cited lemma
a build row validated against the MTC axioms or an exact certificate may use any source and oracle

stakeholders.name: Reader
stakeholders.text: Reads the UOR Atlas whitepaper and needs every established claim to rest on an external anchor and every cited lemma to be disclosed.

stakeholders.name: Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Adds dictionary rows and feature files and needs to know which rule a row breaks before CI does.

concerns.name: No status inflation
concerns.text: No in-repo derivation or open measurement is billed as some-true or as a gating suite.

components.name: F1 Atlas formalization
components.text: The Lean formalization of the UOR Atlas whose theorems anchor some-true rows.

components.name: holospaces
components.text: The content-addressing substrate whose vv witnesses anchor some-true rows.

components.name: uor-addr
components.text: The realized composition operations that anchor some-true rows.

threats.name: Status inflation
threats.text: A derived construction is recorded as some-true to make it read as established.

control.name: External-anchor rule
control.text: A some-true row with a parenthetical source is never admitted.

threats.name: Open claim gated as established
threats.text: The advantage row, open and measured, is moved into a gating suite.

control.name: Tier discipline
control.text: An open row in a gating suite is never admitted.

threats.name: Undisclosed trust boundary
threats.text: A conclusion rests on a classical lemma the row cites but its prose does not name.

control.name: Cited-lemma disclosure
control.text: Every cited lemma must appear verbatim in the row prose.

quality.text: No some-true row with a parenthetical source and no open row in a suite is admitted.
quality.measureText: Requests breaking the external-anchor or tier rule that answer admitted.

quality.text: Every row is decided against exactly the three levels model/status.toml declares.
